---
name: Hardware installation trial / 実機導入確認
about: Help verify a first installation on another device
---

English or Japanese is welcome. Please leave personal paths, tokens, runtime
files and copyrighted/private media out of the report.

- Device model / 機種:
- Host name and version / ホスト名・版:
- Windows and Python version / Windows・Python版:
- First install or update / 初回導入・更新:
- Guide followed / 使用した手順:
- Profile visible and assigned / プロファイル表示・割当:
- Artwork visible / ジャケット表示:
- Large-knob Play/Pause works / 大ノブの再生・停止:
- Previous/next works / 前曲・次曲:
- Original profile still works / 元のプロファイルへの復帰:
- Problem and redacted error text / 問題・個人情報を除いたエラー文:

For this first test, optional Spotify API/YouTube setup is not required.
